purpose: fresh acceptance-bearing four-route agent-blinded extraction for G2-C04 and G2-C07
lineage: new prospective lineage; not packet 06 and not a repair, continuation or promotion of any prior packet

design.role_separation: two fresh extraction agents with no access to each other, prior outputs, expected values or answer-bearing locators
design.artifact_isolation: separate source-only bundles and write-only output directories; comparison begins only after both outputs are sealed
design.contract: prospectively frozen neutral semantic contract with no expected values or locator text
design.quarantine: all rows remain quarantined regardless of concordance
design.claim_limit: bounded reproducibility only; no unseen-edition or generalisation claim

stopping_rules: any critical discrepancy terminates the lineage
any role-isolation or artifact-binding failure terminates the lineage
no sealed-output repair, reuse or calibration rerun
no retrospective promotion of packet 05 or the two-row known-source result
required_owner_decision: clarify that agent-blinded known-edition evidence may satisfy C04/C07 for bounded reproducibility and supersede only the earlier project-unseen acceptance condition
prohibitions: G2 passage before all criteria and separate gate acceptance
